look_here_first: Start at the small annual taproot and opposite oval to elliptic leaves; then inspect the lower third of the 5-6 mm calyx tube for its distinctive swollen (saccate) side. Flowers have a 9-13 mm, noninflated pink corolla. Do not rely on color alone.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Delicate annual, often 5-30 cm, slender taproot; dry rocky limestone habitat.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Opposite, broadly elliptic or ovate, usually not over three times as long as wide, shortly petiolate, often slightly toothed and relatively glabrous; basal leaves sometimes purplish.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Calyx about 5-6 mm, lower third of tube saccate; corolla pink 9-13 mm, not inflated.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Annual root rather than persistent woody crown

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Broadish opposite leaves on a slender plant

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Saccate lower calyx tube; noninflated corolla
